judged.what: The creator hypes up 100 Thieves closing out a round against LOUD, shouting "Let's go Asuna!" and telling Cryo his only job in life is to play back.
judged.reason: The play is a standard round win without a spectacular multi-kill or clutch play. While his reactions and play-by-play commentary are energetic, it lacks the exceptional play quality needed to stand out.
